name: content-moderation
description: Triage user-generated content into review queues — spam / toxic / safe / contains-pii.
use_case: First-pass moderation for forums / chat / reviews — humans review only flagged items.

classes.name: safe
examples: Great article, thanks for sharing!
I learned something new from this post
Has anyone tried the new feature in version 2?
Looking forward to the next release
Can someone help me with this configuration?
Just wanted to say thanks to the team
Here is a useful resource for beginners
Excellent walkthrough, very clear

classes.name: spam
examples: Buy cheap watches at our store now click here
Make money from home with this one trick doctors hate
Free iPhone winner just claim now act fast
Visit our website to get rich quick guaranteed
Limited time offer expires soon don't miss out
100% legitimate investment opportunity huge returns
Crypto pumping group join now massive gains
Click my profile for adult content

classes.name: toxic
examples: You are a complete idiot and don't deserve respect
I hope you fail and lose everything
Get out of here you worthless person
This is the dumbest thing I've ever read shut up
I can't stand seeing your stupid posts
You should be banned forever for this
Anyone who agrees with this is brain dead
Insulting personal attack on community member
